situations.title: 쇼크 초기 관류 사정
situations.tagline: I feel so cold and dizzy, and my hands are all clammy — what's happening to me?
situations.brief: 피부, 의식 수준, 소변량 등 관류 지표를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking your skin, alertness, and urine output to see how your body is doing.
Your hands feel cool, so I'm looking at your circulation.
I'll keep a close eye on these signs and update the team.

situations.title: 젖산 채혈·경향 추적
situations.tagline: Can you send a repeat lactate so we can see if it's clearing?
situations.brief: 젖산의 의미를 이해하고 재검을 통해 경향을 추적하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll draw a repeat lactate to track the trend.
A falling lactate usually means perfusion is improving.
I'll report the new value as soon as it results.

situations.title: 대량 수액 볼루스 투여 협조
situations.tagline: Let's get a liter of crystalloid in wide open and watch how he responds.
situations.brief: 정질액 볼루스를 투여하고 반응을 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll run the fluid bolus wide open.
Let's watch his pressure and heart rate as it goes in.
I'll listen to his lungs so we don't overload him.

situations.title: 쇼크 유형 병력 청취
situations.tagline: It all started with a fever and then I just couldn't stand up — is that important?
situations.brief: 쇼크 감별을 위해 필요한 병력을 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me when your symptoms first started?
Have you had any fever, bleeding, or chest pain?
This helps us figure out what's causing your shock.

situations.title: 시간당 소변량 모니터
situations.tagline: How much has she put out through the Foley this past hour?
situations.brief: 시간당 소변량을 측정해 신관류 지표로 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Her urine output is about 20 mls this hour, which is low.
I'm tracking it hourly as a marker of kidney perfusion.
I'll flag it to the team if it stays below target.

situations.title: 말초·중심 체온차 관찰
situations.tagline: My feet feel like ice even though the rest of me feels warm — is that normal?
situations.brief: 말초와 중심 체온차를 관찰해 관류 저하 단서를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Your feet are cool while your chest is warm, so I'm checking your circulation.
This temperature gap can be a clue about your blood flow.
I'll monitor it and let the team know.

situations.title: 저혈량 쇼크 출혈원 감별
situations.tagline: His pressure keeps dropping and his belly's getting firm — is this a bleed?
situations.brief: 출혈과 탈수를 감별하고 수혈 필요성을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His hemoglobin is dropping and his abdomen is distending.
This looks like active bleeding, not just dehydration.
Let's type and cross and get blood ready.

situations.title: 분포성 쇼크 초기 소생
situations.tagline: She's warm and vasodilated — how do you want to balance fluids and pressors?
situations.brief: 수액과 승압의 균형을 맞춰 분포성 쇼크를 소생하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's give fluids first and start pressors if she stays hypotensive.
She's warm and vasodilated, which fits distributive shock.
We'll titrate to a MAP target as we go.

situations.title: 심인성 쇼크 감별
situations.tagline: His lungs are wet and his pressure's low — I don't think this one wants more fluid.
situations.brief: 폐부종 여부를 확인하고 수액 제한을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: He has crackles and low pressure, so this may be cardiogenic.
Pushing more fluid could worsen his pulmonary edema.
Let's consider inotropes instead of a bolus.

situations.title: 폐색성 쇼크 인지
situations.tagline: His trachea's shifting and he's crashing — could this be a tension pneumo?
situations.brief: 긴장성 기흉이나 심장압전 등 즉각 감압이 필요한 폐색성 쇼크를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: His trachea is deviated and breath sounds are absent on one side.
This looks like a tension pneumothorax that needs decompression now.
I'm calling the physician for an emergent needle decompression.

situations.title: 수액 과다와 부족 경계 판단
situations.tagline: We've given a lot of fluid — how do we know when to stop before her lungs flood?
situations.brief: 폐부종 징후를 통합해 수액 과다와 부족의 경계를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's reassess her lungs and oxygen before the next bolus.
If she's developing crackles, we hold the fluids.
We want enough volume without tipping her into pulmonary edema.

situations.title: 아나필락시스 쇼크 대응
situations.tagline: She's wheezing and her lips are swelling after the antibiotic — this is anaphylaxis!
situations.brief: 에피네프린을 투여하고 기도를 감시하며 아나필락시스 쇼크에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the antibiotic — this is anaphylaxis.
Give IM epinephrine now.
I'm watching her airway closely for swelling.

situations.title: 젖산 클리어런스 목표 평가
situations.tagline: Her repeat lactate came back — are we clearing it fast enough?
situations.brief: 젖산 클리어런스를 목표에 맞춰 평가하고 소생 반응을 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Her lactate dropped from 6 to 4, so it's clearing.
We're aiming for at least a 10 percent clearance.
If it stalls, we reassess our resuscitation.

situations.title: 승압제 시작 시점 소통
situations.tagline: She's had two boluses and she's still hypotensive — time to call for pressors?
situations.brief: 수액 불응을 판단하고 승압제 시작 시점을 의사에게 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: She's remained hypotensive despite adequate fluids.
I think it's time to start a pressor.
I'm calling the physician to recommend norepinephrine.

situations.title: 쇼크 중 산-염기 교정 판단
situations.tagline: His gas shows a bad metabolic acidosis — do we treat the number or the cause?
situations.brief: ABG를 통합 해석해 쇼크 중 산-염기 교정 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His gas shows a severe metabolic acidosis with a high lactate.
The priority is fixing the perfusion, not just the pH.
We'll consider bicarbonate only in specific situations.

situations.title: 다장기부전 동반 불응성 쇼크
situations.tagline: Her kidneys and liver are failing now on top of the shock — where do we go from here?
situations.brief: 다장기부전을 인지하고 치료 목표를 재설정하세요.
keyPhrases: She's now in multi-organ failure despite maximal support.
We need to reassess our goals of treatment.
Let's bring the team and family together for a plan.

situations.title: 대량 출혈 쇼크 대량수혈 발동
situations.tagline: He's hemorrhaging fast — activate the massive transfusion protocol now!
situations.brief: 대량수혈 프로토콜을 활성화하고 팀을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Activate the massive transfusion protocol.
I need the cooler with packed cells, plasma, and platelets.
Let's assign roles so the products keep flowing.

situations.title: 심장압전 응급 심낭천자 보조
situations.tagline: Her heart sounds are muffled and she's tamponading — set up for a pericardiocentesis, stat!
situations.brief: 급변하는 심장압전 상황에서 응급 심낭천자를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Muffled heart sounds and low pressure — this looks like tamponade.
I'll set up the pericardiocentesis tray and prime the monitor.
I'm ready to assist and document the procedure.

situations.title: 긴장성 기흉 응급 감압
situations.tagline: No breath sounds on the right and he's crashing — we need to decompress now!
situations.brief: 긴장성 기흉을 즉시 감압하고 감압 후 재사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Absent breath sounds and hypotension — this is a tension pneumothorax.
Get the needle for immediate decompression.
After decompression, I'll reassess his breath sounds and vitals.

situations.title: 쇼크 후 심정지 임박
situations.tagline: She's about to arrest — call the code team and let's assign roles!
situations.brief: 심정지 임박 상황에서 소생팀을 호출하고 역할을 분담하세요.
keyPhrases: She's peri-arrest — call the code team now.
You take compressions, I'll manage the airway.
Someone get the crash cart and start documenting.

situations.title: 소생 목표와 무의미성 갈등
situations.tagline: You keep talking about what's realistic, but I'm not ready to give up on him.
situations.brief: 가족 및 팀과 함께 치료 목표에 관해 신중히 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: I understand how hard this is, and we're not giving up on him.
I want to talk about what he would have wanted.
Let's decide together what care makes sense for him now.
